name: TF-Luna LiDAR Distance Sensor
description: The `tfluna` sensor platform allows you to use the TF-Luna distance sensor ([datasheet](https://files.waveshare.com/upload/a/ac/SJ-PM-TF-Luna_A05_Product_Manual.pdf)) with ESPHome to measure distances. The sensor works optically by emitting short infrared pulses and measuring the time it takes the light to be reflected back.

config_entries.label: Address
config_entries.description: Manually specify the I²C address of the sensor. Defaults to `0x10`.

config_entries.label: I2C ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID of the [I²C Component](https://esphome.io/components/i2c/). Defaults to the default I²C bus.

config_entries.label: Update Interval
config_entries.description: The interval to check the sensor. Defaults to `1s`.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID for this TF-Luna hub. Use this if you have multiple sensors, so the sensor, button and text sensor platforms can refer to it with `tfluna_id`.
